source_findings.title: Grey heron (Ardea cinerea) on the Aran Islands.webm
source_findings.finding: Grey heron visible in shallow tidal water at all sampled points, but small and distant; no fishing strike or caught prey visible.
source_findings.verdict: REJECT_FOR_FISHING_STRIKE; possible distant water habitat B-roll only after motion/seek verification

source_findings.title: Giraffe eating leaves.webm
source_findings.finding: Giraffe visibly reaches leafy vegetation in a natural-looking landscape; framing is wide and branches partially obscure mouth. Individual leaf bite is not established by three stills.
source_findings.verdict: CONDITIONAL_BROWSING_CONTEXT; requires full action-window/mouth movement review before assigning feeding tag

source_findings.title: Papilio machaon - Kanagawa 2025 7 13.webm
source_findings.finding: Swallowtail visible among flowers at first and final sample, smaller/distant at middle. Wing markings are identifiable in closer samples; wing-flick defense not established.
source_findings.verdict: CONDITIONAL_WING_PATTERN; do not assign deimatic warning action without footage evidence

source_findings.title: Male lion and cubs.webm
